name: @payswap/surface
description: The stable, versioned, React-free surface API for every journey the PaySwap universal interface exposes (Work Order P4-W4-002): the five outcome actions (Pay/Receive/Move/Convert/Checkout) with their honest dispatchability facts, the eleven operational areas of the navigation IA derived from the Stripe UX research, exact integer minor-unit money display, the BLOCK/ALLOW/UNKNOWN security gate vocabulary folded into people-language, and the conversion disclosure fold over the REAL route-compiler output contracts — typed contracts a future browser extension or mobile app consumes WITHOUT React, WITHOUT Next.js and WITHOUT any UI framework.
